title: Breaking the Data Barrier: LexiCore - A Lexicon-First Hybrid System for Extremely Low-Resource Translation

contributions.purpose: 提出词典优先三阶段混合翻译系统LexiCore
contributions.mechanism: 1785词典查询+15条语法规则+受限GPT-3.5仅改语法不翻译
contributions.domain: 极低资源机器翻译/构造语
contributions.source_quote: We present LexiCore, a lexicon-first hybrid translation system that achieves 18.92 BLEU on Dothraki-English translation using only 2,254 parallel examples—a 4,438-fold data deficit compared to neural requirements.

contributions.purpose: 论证显式语言知识可替代统计学习(记录14条失败)
contributions.mechanism: 系统对比神经/规则/词典各法
contributions.evaluation: 14种神经法均0.00 BLEU vs LexiCore 18.92;GPT-4 few-shot 15.97但不可扩展
contributions.source_quote: Our key contribution is demonstrating that for languages with formal specifications, explicit linguistic knowledge can substitute for statistical learning.

notes: 数据红旗(择优/矛盾):摘要18.92 BLEU取自200样本,但表1 Test A(100样本)=23.66、5组均值仅18.36;"28% high-quality"取自200样本而5组均值仅21.1%。表1"Exact Matches"在样本量100/200/300三组恒为7——雷同可疑。阶段数字矛盾:表3 Stage1(Dictionary)=10.45 BLEU但表2 H12(Dictionary-only)=3.39 BLEU,同为词典基线差约3倍。正文引入未定义符号"H15"(讨论中把LexiCore称H15但从未列出)。图1/2/3均泛描述"comprehensive analysis",疑似自动生成占位图。诚实处:H7检索93.77 BLEU标为测试集污染并弃用、14条0.00 BLEU负结果均有记录。checklist AI披露:实验[D]全AI、分析[C]、写作[C];AI局限自认最初盲目追复杂神经方案、需人类识别检索污染。外部效度:仅GPT-3.5、单构造语。摘要多句被截断无句号。
